title: Valid Currency Codes
applicability: Applies to Currency Code Element 20 and conditional currency subfields in Segment 100-related variable/EBT data.

classificationEvidence.scope: Three-digit source code recognition and Visa/MC/Both classification only; no per-transaction network/country eligibility, Element 76 implied-decimal, Appendix I Table 006/056, or Appendix M fixed-840 HIP subelement certification.

businessRequirements.title: A currency value used by a Segment 100 transaction context shall use a valid three-digit Appendix L Currency Code.
businessRequirements.coverageNote: All 153 distinct Appendix L codes and format/unknown-code negatives are covered by the linked classification chain package.

businessRequirements.title: Currency Code usage shall be consistent with the applicable Visa, MasterCard, or both-card-network designation.
Currency subfields in eWIC WIC Discount Amount and related variable data shall use a valid Appendix L code.

testCases.positive: Valid three-digit currency code such as 840

negative: Currency code conflicts with network or eWIC subfield context

testDataStatus: All 153 distinct Appendix L codes (161 source rows), including the six network-scope-conflict codes, plus 10 unknown-but-well-formed and 10 malformed-format negatives, have independent executable classification chains in the linked package. Network-specific/country-specific eligibility, Element 76 implied-decimal, Appendix I Table 006/056, and Appendix M fixed-840 HIP subelement rules remain separate and unresolved.
remaining: Validate all currency codes used by AI-generated transaction and eWIC artifacts against the classification package.
Resolve per-country network-specific currency applicability for codes 230, 356, 578, 710, 840, and 978 through source/client review.
Confirm the Element 76 implied-decimal, Appendix I Table 006 (Currency Code Information) vs. Element 20, Table 056 MIT Amount same-currency, and Appendix M fixed-840 HIP subelement relationships.
